business_summary: Beijing Changjiu Logistics Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides logistics services for the automobile industry chain in China and internationally. The company offers vehicle logistics services, including road transportation, multimodal transportation, social vehicle, and warehousing solutions; and international services, such as railway, road, ocean shipping, and air, as well as value-added services comprising packaging, vehicle trade and logistics, overseas warehousing and distribution, overseas agency, customs clearance, and others. It also provides energy logistics; storage and charging integration services, which include planning and design, EPC engineering, intelligent operation and maintenance, integrated energy services, and integrated whole-link solutions; and power battery recycling. In addition, the company is involved in the international freight forwarding and shipping businesses; technology promotion and application; solar power generation technology; wholesale and retail; software development; information technology; boat rental; energy and logistics information consulting; vehicle repair; energy storage product sales; and carbon emission reduction, conversion, capture, and storage technology research and development. It serves automobile manufacturers, dealers, and original equipment manufacturers. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Beijing, China. Beijing Changjiu Logistics Co.,Ltd is a subsidiary of Jilin Changjiu Industry Group Co., Ltd.
